keyPoints.en: 8 bits = 1 byte (0–255). byte < KB < MB < GB < TB.
keyPoints.bm: 8 bit = 1 bait (0–255). bait < KB < MB < GB < TB.

keyPoints.en: Lists: marks = [70, 85, 92]; marks[0] = 70; marks[-1] = 92; len(marks) = 3; marks.append(60).
keyPoints.bm: Senarai: marks = [70, 85, 92]; marks[0] = 70; marks[-1] = 92; len(marks) = 3; marks.append(60).

keyPoints.en: Strings can be indexed and sliced: "Python"[1:4] = "yth".
Linear search: any list, checks one by one. Binary search: sorted list, halves each step.
keyPoints.bm: Carian linear: mana-mana senarai, semak satu demi satu. Carian perduaan: senarai terisih, bahagi dua setiap langkah.

keyPoints.en: Bubble sort swaps neighbouring items; after each pass the largest item reaches the end.
keyPoints.bm: Isihan buih menukar item bersebelahan; selepas setiap laluan item terbesar sampai ke hujung.

tip.en: Binary search on unsorted data gives wrong answers.
tip.bm: Carian perduaan pada data tidak terisih memberi jawapan salah.
